# Cadastre reference

<!-- Generated by `UPDATE_REFERENCE=1 cargo test -p cadastre-core reference`: do not edit. -->

The exact language: its syntax, from the grammar (`grammar/src/grammar.json`), and what the compiler knows, from its tables (`schema.rs`, `vocabulary.rs`). The [guide](guide.md) explains it with examples.

A key of a resource or a link that is not listed here is a **free key**: accepted, not checked, compared on its raw text in filters, never proposed by completion.

## 1. Syntax

Notation: `a b` sequence, `a | b` choice, `a?` optional, `a*` zero or more, `a+` one or more, `( )` grouping, `"x"` keyword or punctuation, `/x/` regular expression, `name:x` a named part, `~x` written right after the previous token, without space. Whitespace and comments (`comment`) may appear between any two tokens. Rules starting with `_` only group alternatives.

Operators bind from the tightest: `not`, `and`, `or`, `aggregate`, `selection`.

### Registry

```
source_file       ::= (kind_declaration | link_declaration | group_declaration | process | resource | link | for_each | view | check | style_block)*
for_each          ::= "for_each" (variable:identifier | "(" variable:identifier ("," variable:identifier)* ")") "in" items:(list | csv) "{" (resource | link | inline_link | for_each)* "}"
kind_declaration  ::= "kind" name:identifier "{" ((key_declaration | comment) ","?)* "}"
group_declaration ::= "group" name:identifier ":" member:identifier ("|" member:identifier)*
csv               ::= "csv" "(" path:string ")"
link_declaration  ::= ("link" | "layer" layer:identifier) "{" ((key_declaration | comment) ","?)* "}"
key_declaration   ::= key:identifier ":" type:type required:required?
required          ::= "(" "required" ")"
type              ::= (name:identifier | "ref" ~"(" kinds:kinds ")" | "pattern" ~"(" pattern:string ")") cardinality:cardinality? | values:choices
kinds             ::= identifier ("|" identifier)*
choices           ::= identifier ("|" identifier)+
cardinality       ::= ~"+" | ~"*" | ~"{" number "}"
resource          ::= virtual:"virtual"? kind:identifier name:identifier body:block?
block             ::= "{" ((attribute | resource | process | inline_link | for_each | selection) ","?)* "}"
attribute         ::= key:identifier ":" value:_value
process           ::= "process" name:identifier "{" ((attribute | participant | step | loop | comment) ","?)* "}"
participant       ::= "participant" name:identifier label:string? members:list
step              ::= "step" source:_reference ("->" target:_reference (":" port:port_spec)? layers:layers? | text:string) body:step_block?
step_block        ::= "{" ((attribute | flag:identifier) ","?)* "}"
loop              ::= "loop" label:string "{" ((step | loop | comment) ","?)* "}"
link              ::= source:_reference "->" _link_tail
inline_link       ::= "->" _link_tail
_link_tail        ::= target:_reference (":" port:port_spec)? layers:layers? body:link_block?
link_block        ::= "{" (attribute ","?)* "}"
port_spec         ::= protocol:identifier (~"/" port:~/\d+(-\d+)?/)?
layers            ::= "[" (identifier ("," identifier)* ","?)? "]"
```

### Values

```
_reference        ::= identifier | qualified_name
_value            ::= _scalar | list
_scalar           ::= identifier | qualified_name | number | quantity | semver | ipv4 | cidr4 | ipv6 | cidr6 | string
list              ::= "[" ((_scalar | list) ("," (_scalar | list))* ","?)? "]"
```

### Tokens

```
identifier        ::= /[a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*(-[a-zA-Z0-9_$]+)*/
qualified_name    ::= /[a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*(-[a-zA-Z0-9_$]+)*(\.[a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*(-[a-zA-Z0-9_$]+)*)+/
number            ::= /\d+(\.\d+)?/
quantity          ::= /\d+(\.\d+)?[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z]*(\/[a-zA-Z]+)?/
semver            ::= /v?\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[0-9A-Za-z-]+(\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)?(\+[0-9A-Za-z-]+(\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)?/
ipv4              ::= /\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}/
cidr4             ::= /\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}\/\d{1,2}/
ipv6              ::= /(([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){7}[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}|(([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){0,6}[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4})?::(([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){0,6}[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4})?)/
cidr6             ::= /(([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){7}[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}|(([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){0,6}[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4})?::(([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){0,6}[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4})?)\/\d{1,3}/
string            ::= "\"" (/[^"\\\n]+/ | /\\./)* "\""
comment           ::= "//" /[^\r\n]*/ | "/*" /[^*]*\*+([^/*][^*]*\*+)*/ "/"
```

### Plans

```
view              ::= "view" name:identifier "{" (select_clause | zone_clause | edges_clause | style_block | render_clause | attribute)* "}"
check             ::= "check" name:identifier "{" (select_clause | edges_clause | expect_clause | attribute)* "}"
expect_clause     ::= "expect" expectation:("none" | "some" | count | all)
count             ::= "count" operator:("=" | "!=" | "<" | "<=" | ">" | ">=") value:number
all               ::= "all" _predicate
zone_clause       ::= "zone" name:identifier label:string? (members:list | where_clause) _style_properties?
select_clause     ::= "select" kind:identifier ("," kind:identifier)* where_clause? with_ends? without_isolated? group_by?
selection         ::= "select" /\s+/ kind:identifier ("," kind:identifier)* where_clause?
with_ends         ::= "with" "ends"
without_isolated  ::= "without" "isolated"
group_by          ::= "group-by" level:identifier (">" level:identifier)*
edges_clause      ::= "edges" (edge_selector | edges_option) ("," (edge_selector | edges_option))*
edge_selector     ::= selector:_selector where_clause?
_selector         ::= layers | identifier | lift | follow | process_selector | path_selector
process_selector  ::= "process" ~"(" name:_reference ")"
path_selector     ::= "path" ~"(" from:_reference "," to:_reference ")"
edges_option      ::= key:identifier ":" value:identifier
lift              ::= "lift" "(" edges:edge_selector ("," lift_option)* ")"
lift_option       ::= key:identifier ":" value:path
follow            ::= "follow" "(" data:_reference ("," follow_option)* ")"
follow_option     ::= key:identifier ":" value:(_reference | list)
path              ::= path_step (~"." path_step)*
path_step         ::= step:(identifier | ancestor | call) optional:~"?"?
ancestor          ::= "ancestor" "(" kind:identifier ")"
call              ::= function:identifier ~"(" argument:identifier ")"
where_clause      ::= "where" _predicate
_predicate        ::= flag | comparison | has | in | exists | and | or | not | parenthesized
flag              ::= attribute:path
aggregate         ::= function:identifier ~"(" path:path ")"
comparison        ::= left:(path | aggregate) operator:("=" | "!=" | "<" | "<=" | ">" | ">=") right:(_scalar | right_path)
right_path        ::= head:(identifier | qualified_name) (~"(" kind:identifier ")" optional:~"?"? | optional:~"?") (~"." path_step)*
has               ::= left:path "has" right:_scalar
in                ::= left:path "in" right:list
exists            ::= "exists" "(" attribute:path ")"
and               ::= _predicate "and" _predicate
or                ::= _predicate "or" _predicate
not               ::= "not" _predicate
parenthesized     ::= "(" _predicate ")"
style_block       ::= "style" "{" (layer_style | kind_style | nodes_style | edges_style)* "}"
layer_style       ::= "layer" layer:identifier where_clause? _style_properties
kind_style        ::= "kind" kind:identifier where_clause? _style_properties
nodes_style       ::= "nodes" where_clause? _style_properties
edges_style       ::= "edges" where_clause? _style_properties
_style_properties ::= "{" (attribute ","?)* "}"
render_clause     ::= "render" format:identifier ("," format:identifier)* ("{" (attribute ","?)* "}")?
```

## 2. Resources and links

Types: `string`; `number`; `semver` (`1.2.0`, `v2.0.1-rc1`); `version` (a semver, a number or a string); `ip`; `cidr`; `host name` (`labels.example.com`, bare or quoted); `a | b` one of these words; `ref(k)` the name of a resource of kind or group `k`. A list is written `[a, b]`; a single value may be written without brackets.

### Keys of every resource

| Key | Type | Count | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | one |  |
| `description` | `string` | one |  |
| `confidence` | `confirmed \| assumed \| doubtful` | one |  |
| `question` | `string, or list of strings` | one |  |
| `scope` | `internal \| external` | one |  |
| `owner` | `ref(team)` | one |  |
| `operator` | `ref(team)` | one |  |
| `reach` | `internet \| internal` | one |  |
| `sequence_label` | `string` | one |  |

`parent: <name>`, on a resource declared at the root, places it in a resource of one of its parent kinds (below), as if it were nested in its block; never on a nested resource, nor on a kind always at the root.

### Keys of links

On `->` links, in their block.

| Key | Type | Count | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | `string` | one |  |
| `confidence` | `confirmed \| assumed \| doubtful` | one |  |
| `question` | `string, or list of strings` | one |  |
| `carries` | `ref(data)` | list |  |
| `exchange` | `push \| pull \| both` | one |  |
| `channel` | `ref(channel)` | list |  |
| `through` | `ref(transit)` | list |  |
| `processes` | `ref(process)` | list |  |

### Kinds within a resource

Details of a resource, declared in its block only: an interface of a device, a component of an app, a channel of a broker, a participant of a process. Resources like the others (named, resolved, referenced, renamed), listed here apart from the kinds of the map.

#### `interface`

In: `server`, `firewall`, `router`, `switch`, `vpn_gateway`, `device`.

| Key | Type | Count | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subnet` | `ref(subnet)` | one |  |
| `ip` | `ip` | one |  |
| `peer` | `ref(interface \| server)` | one |  |
| `vlan` | `number` | one |  |
| `vlans` | `number` | list |  |
| `aggregate` | `string` | one |  |

#### `participant`

In: `process`.

| Key | Type | Count | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `members` | `ref(flow_endpoint \| cluster)` | list |  |

In: `app`.

|---|---|---|---|

| `url` | `url (string)` | list |  |
| `license` | `spdx (string)` | one |  |

In: `saas`, `app`, `server`.

| Key | Type | Count | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `topic \| queue \| directory \| bucket` | one | yes |
| `carries` | `ref(data)` | list |  |

### Groups

A group stands for its kinds wherever a kind is expected (`ref(transit)`, `select network_device`).

| Group | Kinds |
|---|---|
| `network_device` | `router`, `switch`, `firewall`, `vpn_gateway`, `forward_proxy`, `load_balancer`, `proxy`, `device` |
| `connector` | `vpn_tunnel`, `vpc_peering`, `wan_link` |
| `transit` | `router`, `switch`, `firewall`, `vpn_gateway`, `forward_proxy`, `device`, `vpn_tunnel`, `vpc_peering`, `wan_link` |
| `flow_endpoint` | `app`, `job`, `database`, `saas`, `server`, `fleet`, `load_balancer`, `proxy`, `vip`, `device`, `actor`, `internet` |

## 3. Plans

### Formats of `render`

| Format | Output |
|---|---|
| `svg` | diagram laid out by Graphviz (`dot`), with icons |
| `dot` | Graphviz source |
| `text` | nodes and edges as indented text, with their provenance |
| `mermaid` | Mermaid flowchart (ELK layout) |
| `sequence` | Mermaid sequence diagram of the steps of the processes the view selects (`edges process(orders)`) |
| `traversal` | SVG of the devices traversed, a row per path (`edges path(a, b)`) and per step of the processes (`edges process(orders)`) |
| `ascii` | ASCII art, laid out by the compiler |
| `csv` | table, comma-separated values: a row per node, or per edge when the view has edges |
| `tsv` | table, tab-separated values, as Excel pastes them |
| `markdown` | table in Markdown |
| `html` | table in an HTML page, to open in a browser |
| `xlsx` | table in an Excel workbook: the header frozen, filters, numbers and links typed |
| `drawio` | diagram to edit in draw.io (diagrams.net), laid out by Graphviz |

### Options of `render`

| Option | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | `lr \| rl \| tb \| bt` | `lr` | direction of the edges: left to right, right to left, top to bottom, bottom to top |
| `orientation` | `connection \| data` | `connection` | arrow from the initiator of the connection, or along the data (`exchange`) |
| `node_labels` | `[<key>, …]` | `[label]` | attributes shown in nodes and frames |
| `edge_labels` | `[<label>, …]` | `[port]` | labels of the edges; unless written, a diagram of more than 20 edges leaves them to the tooltips |
| `legend` | `true \| false` | `false` | legend of the style rules carrying a `legend` |
| `icons` | `true \| false` | `true` | icon of its kind in each node and frame |
| `satellites` | `true \| false` | `true` | a node exchanging with two frames or more drawn once in each of them, in gray, rather than once with every edge pulled to it (SVG) |
| `twins` | `true \| false` | `true` | in a frame, the nodes of one kind with exactly the same edges drawn as one box listing them, with one edge per shared exchange (SVG) |
| `title` | `true \| false` | `true` | title of a sequence diagram drawing a single process: its label |
| `columns` | `[<key or path>, …]` |  | columns of a table (`csv`, `tsv`, `markdown`): keys, pseudo-attributes or paths, `"ancestor(site)"` quoted |
| `rows` | `nodes \| edges` |  | rows of a table: one per node, or one per edge; by default per edge when the view has edges |
| `merge_label` | `list \| count \| <number>` | `list` | label of an edge merging links: their labels, or a summary (`sftp ×9`, the detail in the tooltip) from 2 links (`count`) or from a number of links |

#### Layout hints

Options that only steer where a diagram puts things, when the default layout does not read well; the layout engine decides, and a hint it cannot follow is ignored. Rarely needed.

| Option | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `layout` | `graphviz \| elk` | `graphviz` | engine laying out the SVG: Graphviz, or Eclipse ELK (a compiler built with the `elk` feature), drawn by the compiler |
| `stack` | `[<resource> \| [<resource>, …], …]` | `[]` | frames or nodes placed in this order along the direction; a nested list puts several on a level |
| `cross` | `[<resource>, …]` | `[]` | frames or nodes placed in this order across the direction |
| `first` | `[<resource>, …]` | `[]` | frames or nodes placed first in their frame: at the top in `tb` and `bt`, at the left in `lr` and `rl` |
| `last` | `[<resource>, …]` | `[]` | frames or nodes placed last in their frame |
| `routing` | `curved \| polyline \| straight \| orthogonal` | `curved` | shape of the edges: curves, broken lines, straight lines, horizontal and vertical segments |
| `edge_labels_wrap` | `<number> \| values` |  | labels on several lines: a line break between values beyond a number of characters, or one value per line |
| `edge_labels_layout` | `nodes \| free` | `nodes` | labels laid out as nodes on the edges, or placed on the edges after the layout, without moving anything |
| `spacing` | `<number> \| [<number>, <number>]` | `1` | space between the nodes and between the ranks, as a factor: `1.5` for both, `[1, 2]` for the nodes then the ranks |
| `node_label_size` | `<number>` | `10` | size of the text of the nodes, in points |
| `edge_label_size` | `<number>` | `9` | size of the labels of the edges, in points |
| `frame_label_size` | `<number>` | `11` | size of the titles of the frames, in points |

### Attributes of `view`

For the readers of the view: shown by the site, the previews and the playground.

| Option | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `<string>` |  | the title of the view, for its readers; its name otherwise |
| `description` | `<string>` |  | what the view shows and what it is for, a sentence or two |
| `failing` | `[<resource>, …]` |  | a scenario: the resources failing together (a system, as what it contains); `down` the resources unavailable then |

### Values of `edge_labels`

These words, or any key written on the links or the connectors of the edge, or on the two ends of the references it draws (`circuit_id`, `label`).

| Label | Shows |
|---|---|
| `port` | protocol and port of a flow |
| `carries` | the data carried |
| `through` | the devices and tunnels traversed |
| `description` | the descriptions of the links |
| `step` | the step number of a `follow` edge |
| `relation` | the relation name of a reference or connector edge |
| `interface` | the interfaces of the cables between two devices (`render traversal`) |
| `none` | no label |

### Edge selectors

The selectors of `edges`: a list of layers (`[flow, auth]`), `lift(…)`, `follow(…)`, or a relation:

- reference keys: `carries`, `cluster`, `egress`, `ends`, `gateway`, `ingress`, `members`, `on`, `operator`, `owner`, `participants`, `peer`, `pool`, `rack`, `scheduler`, `stores`, `subnet`, `system`;
- `parent`: containment, from a resource to its parent;
- connector kinds: `vpn_tunnel`, `vpc_peering`, `wan_link`, or the group `connector`.

#### Options of `edges`

| Option | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `through` | `show` |  | the devices traversed drawn as nodes |

#### Options of `lift`

| Option | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `via` | `<path>` |  | the path replacing each end (required, unless every kind has its own) |
| `via_<kind>` | `<path>` |  | the path replacing the ends of a kind or a group, before `via`: `via_job: on` |
| `loops` | `drop \| keep` | `drop` | edges whose two ends are replaced by the same resource |
| `merge` | `endpoints \| port \| none` | `endpoints` | one edge per pair of ends, per pair and `port_spec`, or no merging |

#### Options of `follow`

| Option | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | `ref(flow_endpoint)` |  | where the data starts; without it, every link carrying the data |
| `relay` | `[<kind or resource>, …]` |  | kinds or resources passing the data on along links that do not declare it, in the direction of `exchange` or outwards: `relay: [database]`, `relay: [stock.db]` |
| `relay_to` | `[<kind or resource>, …]` |  | the kinds or resources the relayed links may lead to: `relay_to: [app]`; any by default |
| `side` | `[<resource>, …]` |  | data whose links leaving the resources on the way are drawn too, without a step: the calls serving the processing, `side: [sites]`; `side: all`, whatever they carry |

### Levels of `group-by`

A kind, a group, or a reference key (`owner`, `on`…), from the broadest to the finest level: `group-by site > subnet`.

### Filters

The keys of the resources and links, and these pseudo-attributes. Order comparisons (`<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`) need a number or a version on the right, on a `number`, `semver` or `version` key, a free key, `port` or `step`; free keys are compared on their raw text, in order when the value is a number or a version. The first key of a `select` or `kind` filter must exist for the filtered kinds. On edges, the right side of a comparison may be a path starting with `source` or `target` (`source.ancestor(system) != target.ancestor(system)`): `=` holds when both sides share a value, `!=` when they have values and share none, and a side without value makes the comparison false.

| Pseudo-attribute | On | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | nodes and edges | kind of the resource, relation or connector kind of the edge (`link` for a link) |
| `name` | nodes and edges | qualified name |
| `incomplete` | nodes and edges | true if the element is incomplete |
| `source` | edges | source end, usable at the head of a path |
| `target` | edges | target end, usable at the head of a path |
| `proto` | edges | protocol of the `port_spec` |
| `port` | edges | port of the `port_spec`; true if the value falls within a range |
| `parent` | nodes | the parent resource |
| `step` | edges | step of a `follow` edge |
| `hosts` | nodes | the resources whose `on` designates the node, usable at the head of a path |
| `shared` | nodes | true if what the node hosts belongs to at least two systems |
| `virtual` | nodes | true if the node is a virtual machine (`virtual server web01 { on: esx01 }`) |
| `down` | nodes | true if the node is unavailable in the scenario of the view or the check (`failing: [fw01, fw02]`), failing or through them |
| `failures` | nodes | the resources whose failure alone makes the node unavailable (impact analysis), usable at the head of a path |
| `failures(hosting)` | nodes | the same through hosting only (containment, racks, `on`, cluster and pool members, connector ends), not the links: a single point of failure of the hosting |
| `failures(pairs)` | nodes | the resources of the pairs whose failure together, and not of either alone, makes the node unavailable: what its redundancy rests on |

### Zones

A zone is a frame of the view, at the top level, gathering the nodes and frames it names or that match its filter, taken out of their `group-by` frames; a frame comes with its content. Its name designates it in `stack` and `cross`. Properties of its frame:

| Option | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | `<color>` |  | border of the frame |
| `fill` | `<color>` |  | background of the frame |
| `line` | `solid \| dashed \| dotted` | `dashed` | line of the border |
| `in` | `<zone>` |  | the zone the frame is drawn in |

### Style properties

| Property | Values | On | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | `<color>` | nodes and edges |  | outline of a node, border of a frame, line of an edge |
| `fill` | `<color>` | nodes |  | background of a node or a frame |
| `line` | `solid \| dashed \| dotted` | nodes and edges | `solid` | line of an edge or outline of a node |
| `shape` | `box \| rounded \| ellipse \| cylinder \| hexagon \| note` | nodes | `box` | shape of a node |
| `layout` | `free` | edges |  | an edge drawn without placing nodes |
| `routing` | `straight` | edges |  | an edge drawn as a straight line in SVG, from the border of a node to the other, whatever the routing of the view |
| `legend` | `<string>` | nodes and edges |  | entry of the rule in the legend |

### Checks

A `check` selects nodes (`select`) or edges (`edges`, every kind being selected without `select`), as a view does, and states the expected result: on the edges when it has an `edges` clause, on the nodes otherwise. `cadastre check` runs the checks of a valid model; a failing check lists the offending nodes or edges.

| Expectation | Holds when |
|---|---|
| `expect none` | nothing is selected |
| `expect some` | at least one node or edge is selected |
| `expect count <op> N` | the number of selected nodes or edges compared to N (`=`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`) |
| `expect all <predicate>` | every selected node or edge satisfies the predicate, written as in `where` |

#### Attributes of `check`

| Option | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | `<string>` |  | why the rule exists, shown when it fails |
| `severity` | `error \| warning \| info` | `error` | a failure is an error, or a warning for a rule introduced gradually |
| `failing` | `[<resource>, …]` |  | a scenario: the resources failing together (a system, as what it contains); `down` the resources unavailable then |
